title: La Farruca - Masterclass Escuela de Flamenco Manolete

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher leads a group masterclass with energetic vocal counts and active demonstration at the front of the studio. She corrects rhythm and accents directly while students follow along.

lesson_structure.note: Teacher and students practicing footwork together in studio
Teacher explaining the accent on the second beat
Group dancing with clapping and guitar accompaniment

what_works: Clear vocal counting and rhythmic clapping by instructor
what_hinders: Rapid pacing and multiple dancers in frame make individual foot placement hard to see

quotes.text: El segundo que marcamos tiene el acento

evidence_segments.observation: Instructor and students performing rapid flamenco footwork on a studio stage facing forward
evidence_segments.cannot_infer: exact weight distribution due to fast movement

evidence_segments.observation: Instructor facing the class, giving verbal count and gesturing with her arm before moving
Close-up of instructor's legs and shoes demonstrating fast tacandeo/heel work
evidence_segments.cannot_infer: full body posture and arm placement

evidence_segments.observation: Group dancing in a circle with arms raised while people clap along on the sides

extraction.distinctive_method: Combining live guitar accompaniment and hand-clapping circle with the teacher dancing alongside students at full performance speed.
